rules: own rows keep their order; a repeated own item (same kind and id) shows once and counts once
remote candidates keep their order; a repeated uri or kept note id shows once, the first one wins
a remote kept note whose note id is one of my own notes (kind note, not post) is left out
after every 5th own row comes the next 2 remote candidates (fewer if they run out), marked mixed
the pair comes after the 5th, 10th, ... own row even when that row is the last one loaded so far
when mine are done (ownDone), every remote candidate not yet placed follows, marked tail
while mine may go on (ownDone false), no tail is added
with cards (web only): a slot whose own row has a card after the row before it, itself, or the row after it moves one row on; the next slot is 5 rows after the row the pair actually followed

format.remote: list of {key, uri: string|null, keptNoteId: number|null}; keptNoteId null means a pool item
format.ownDone: true when my feed has no next page
format.cards: web only: own row indexes (0-based, over own rows after de-duplication) that a connection card follows
format.expected: rows in order: own:<key>, mixed:<key>, tail:<key>
format.steps: a sequence of states; expectedIsPrefixOfNext tells whether the earlier layout is the start of the next one
format.currentlyDiffers: what a platform's code did when this version was made (iOS 521f1ca, web 6a3ff0ad) where it disagrees with expected; informational, not an answer
